meta.external_exposure_note: H5=w_s_expose_share_page; App DeepLink=a_expose_deeplink_page; attributed by share_id=pid on D0.
meta.new_user_acquisition_note: D0 PID cross-check: distinct registered users where register_campaign_name=game_share; project PID is parsed from AppsFlyer original_url and matched to an official-template project first published and self-shared by its author on registration day.
meta.retention_note: D1 is populated only after the next-day active partition is complete.
meta.template_center_funnel_note: Strict same-day session funnel: dt+uid+pcsid throughout; list-to-Use also matches tl_sid, card-to-Use matches template_id, and Use/Create/success match template_use_id. Each session counts at most once per stage.
meta.feed_funnel_note: Per dt+uid+template_use_id: entry/Create/success are paired by event sequence; Create and success require source=feed.

share_meta.attribution: D0 deduplicated registration UID: AppsFlyer/iOS PID cross-check plus Android GPIR device + said successful-share attribution; official template, first-publish day, and author self-share required

benchmark_share_meta.attribution: All eligible creations; D0 author self-share exposure and acquisition

acquisition_meta.cohort: new users whose final attributed campaign matches template01-template12; split by register_media_source
acquisition_meta.retention_maturity: D1/D3/D7/D14/D30 are hidden until the corresponding active-day partition is complete
